symlinks: Rejected in every directory component and at each leaf by directory-relative O_NOFOLLOW opens; leaf must be regular
read_size: At most 65536 bytes per read; exact bound size plus one-byte EOF check
stability: Compare leaf identity, type, owner, mode, size, mtime, ctime and link count before open, before/after read and through the linked leaf. All bounded reads retain the exact declared content hashes and modes.
ledger: All passes and the failed reviewer analysis are cumulative; no reset
historical_failures: UNCHANGED; unlisted old first-nine and completion result files were not read
